data.body:
AC EVIDENCE (recorded here, in a COMMENT, deliberately — annotating the AC text would be a
material edit that stales the plan-review attestation; box state is normalized out and is safe).

Change 1587 MERGED to main (with 1586, the b2bb split that gave it room).

AC1 — a folded SNAPSHOT is no longer cited.
`_compact_locked` (now compact_txn.py) filters source_uuids by basename, stripping
RETIRED_SUFFIX before testing for the -SNAPSHOT.json suffix. Determined WITHOUT a history
walk: the compactor already knows which files it is folding, so the filename is authoritative
at that point. The normal path now matches the rebuild path, which always skipped snapshots.

AC2 — the six tickets report clean, status UNCHANGED. Verified empirically after the merge by
re-compacting each with the fixed build and re-reading every snapshot's source_event_uuids
against the uuids present on disk:

    316c cited-missing 1 -> 0      be08 cited-missing 1 -> 0
    a6ea cited-missing 1 -> 0      c7c5 cited-missing 1 -> 0
    bbc0 cited-missing 1 -> 0      e0d4 cited-missing 1 -> 0
    tickets still reporting the false positive: 0

All six remain `closed`, exactly as before — the heal rewrote the snapshot's citation list, not
any ticket state. No data migration was needed, as predicted.

AC3 — the b636 guard is NOT weakened. Held-out test
tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_snapshot_source_uuids_aea0.py asserts both directions.
PROVEN by reverting the single expression: assertion 1 fails ("the superseded SNAPSHOT was
cited as a source event") while assertion 2 — delete a retired RAW source, fsck must still
report SNAPSHOT_MISSING_SOURCES — passes UNCHANGED in both states. That is what shows the
change is targeted at the false positive rather than loosening the check.

AC4 — 'Consider recording the folded snapshot uuid distinctly in the SNAPSHOT payload.'
CONSIDERED AND DECLINED, which is what the criterion asks for. Reasons: (a) it is a payload
schema change affecting every future snapshot and every reader of one, for a legacy-data
artifact that cannot recur — post-I1 compaction RETIRES what it folds, so the superseded file
survives as *.retired and counts as present; (b) the filename suffix is already authoritative
at fold time, so the structural form would add a second source of truth for a fact the
compactor already knows. Worth its own ticket if the structural encoding is wanted for other
reasons; it is not needed for this bug and shipping it here would widen a P2 fix into a
format change.
